sources.finding: Historical SIP queries ending at least 15 minutes ago are documented as available without subscription. Requests require API key and secret headers. IEX is a single-venue feed, not consolidated SIP.
sources.limitation: No credentials used or history retrieved. OTC and inactive-symbol coverage require separate validation; free live IEX restrictions must not be incorrectly generalized to all historical SIP requests.

sources.finding: REST supports configurable intervals including five minutes. Basic has two years of history with end-of-day availability and API-key access. Split adjustment defaults to true; intervals with no qualifying trades produce no bar.
sources.limitation: Two years at audit date cannot cover all fixed 2023-2024 development data. End-of-day recency does not mean only daily bars. No request to the market-data endpoint was made.

sources.finding: Minute flat files are explicitly not included in Stocks Basic.
sources.limitation: A displayed file catalogue is not free download entitlement. No paid route used.

sources.finding: Reference API supports a historical date, active filter, delisted_utc and pagination. Default active=true is not an all-history security master.
sources.limitation: Documented capability only. No complete point-in-time membership or ticker-identity dataset was validated.

sources.finding: Historical intraday including five-minute intervals is marked premium and needs an API key. Listing-status utility documents active or delisted symbols as of a historical date.
sources.limitation: Reference capability does not supply a free anonymous intraday bundle. Neither subscription nor key was obtained.

sources.finding: Symbol Lookup explicitly describes information as of the current trading day.
sources.limitation: Current membership cannot certify the historical universe or eliminate survivorship bias.

sources.finding: Core equity session is distinguished from early/late trading; regular core hours are 09:30-16:00 ET and calendar lists shortened days.
sources.limitation: Current page is not a validated complete known-at-time 2023-2026 calendar. America/New_York conversion and historical exceptions remain required.

sources.finding: Corporate Actions package covers dividends, splits, new listings, suspensions and delistings.
sources.limitation: Complete free historical delivery was not established by the product description. No data order placed.

sources.finding: Text fetch returned a JavaScript browser-verification requirement instead of historical-download details.
sources.limitation: ACCESS_UNRESOLVED, not proof of absent history. No challenge bypass or repeated probe.
